Architecture

Three research frontiers

◉
Established physics + engineering

Photon Frontier

Airy diffraction, laser links, photon counting, pulse-position modulation, predictive digital twins and eventually hardware validation.

◇
Relativity + information theory

Causal Frontier

Light cones, Bell no-signalling, mutual information, randomized interventions and explicit leakage tests.

◈
GR baseline; speculation unimplemented

Causal Corridor

Verified Minkowski/Schwarzschild tensors first. Warp/Hyperwave replication and source/energy-condition audits remain research milestones.

Scientific integrity

Show the calculation, not just the concept.

Local test status: 60 passing analytic/numerical assertions. Current 4.24-ly distance is illustrative rather than frozen Gaia data. M-PPM is uncoded; the GR symbolic engine is validated only on Minkowski and Schwarzschild vacuum cases; no physical corridor or verified FTL mechanism exists.

Consult docs/SCIENTIFIC_REPORT.md, VALIDATION.md, LIMITATIONS.md, and results/baselines.json in the repository. Results are independently reproducible using seeded Python scripts.
